updates.prompt:
Lab — The topology is not included in the available source, so PC interface numbers cannot be determined. R1 and R2 are preconfigured and all cabling is in place. Each PC-facing switch port must carry one VLAN and be operational.

1. On SW-1 create VLAN 15 named OPS, and configure the PC1-facing port as an access port in VLAN 15.
2. On SW-2 create VLAN 66 named ENGINEERING, and configure the PC2-facing port as an access port in VLAN 66.
3. On both switches enable the vendor-neutral neighbor discovery protocol on Ethernet0/2 and Cisco CDP on Ethernet0/0.
4. Save the running configuration to NVRAM. Identify PC-facing interfaces from the actual topology before applying the example.
updates.explanation:
拓扑缺失，不能从现有材料确定 PC 接口。分别在两台交换机使用下列模板，替换 PC 接口及 VLAN 名称/编号：

```text
configure terminal
vlan <15_or_66>
 name <OPS_or_ENGINEERING>
exit
interface <PC_facing_interface_from_topology>
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan <15_or_66>
 no shutdown
exit
lldp run
cdp run
interface Ethernet0/2
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
exit
interface Ethernet0/0
 cdp enable
exit
end
copy running-config startup-config
```

SW-1 使用 VLAN 15 / OPS，SW-2 使用 VLAN 66 / ENGINEERING。设备须支持对应接口和命令；`lldp run`、`cdp run` 为全局启用。题目要求这两个端口各启用指定协议，并未要求在同一端口禁用另一协议。用 `show vlan brief`、`show lldp neighbors`、`show cdp neighbors` 验证，并确认邻居侧已启用。原答案图属于另一道 IPv6 题，不能用来推断 PC 接口。
